title: Fixtures index
description: The shape of every contracts/<name>/fixtures/index.json (02-contracts section 2 item 5): each sample payload, the version it was written for, whether its schema must accept or refuse it, what it shows and its source. `npm run contracts:check` checks each listed file; the frozen-contract guard (infra/ci/contract-freeze-guard.mjs) reads `file` and `version` to know which fixtures a frozen version owns.

file.description: The fixture's path inside fixtures/, for example money.ok.json or invalid/money.decimal.json. Unique in the index.

version.description: The contract version the fixture was written for: v1, v1.1, v2 (BP 6.4). A minor version adds fixtures and never edits an old one (item 5).

schema.description: The schema file in this contract's folder that checks it. Left out: <name>.<version>.schema.json, where <name> is the contract's folder.

def.description: The definition under the schema's $defs that checks it, for example money or book.request (item 2). Left out: the schema's root.

table.description: Database parts only (item 3): the table a seed row belongs to. Such a row is checked by the part's contract test against a migrated database (item 12), not by contracts:check; it takes no schema or def.

expect.description: accept: the schema (or table) must take it. refuse: it must be refused, and `shows` says by which rule.

shows.description: What the fixture shows, in plain words.

source.description: The source line it comes from: a step id, an architecture line, a RULES section, an FS row or a decision (item 4).
